nodes.title: Retire the legacy public surface and catalogue-source switch
nodes.summary: Remove the ProviderHandle protocol and its export, provider(), the top-level observations() wrapper, the global stations() and provider_info() tables, product_info, and map_stations in one green breaking-surface PR, deleting or adapting every test that imports or calls those names while routing fetch internally through the registered provider runtime. Preserve m3's products(provider=None) exactly as the sorted canonical product-id list, and preserve providers, find, pick, fetch, fetch_by_provider, as_frame, from_frame, map, and to_utc unchanged. Remove CatalogSource and every source parameter/branch from CatalogueReader, the internal provider protocol/runtime, all thirteen provider module catalogue methods, stubs, and tests so catalogue reads are packaged-only; remove the now-dead invalid/live catalogue routing behavior, but retain the live_stations, live_products, and live_station_products fields as internal committed catalogue-schema data because, after the handle and provider_info paths disappear, they are not reachable through the public package. Keep USGS live behavior that is independent of the withdrawn catalogue selector: the observation engine's observation_source='live' plus usgs_nwis generate_catalogue read_live_native_rows(), refresh_native_table_from_live(), --live maintenance route, and their tests. Acceptance evidence is updated focused discovery, fetch, registry, provider, catalogue-reader, mapping, and USGS tests; a tests/test_package assertion over non-underscore dir(rivretrieve) names proving the set is exactly the shipped surface plus whatever m5 decides about RawMode and proving provider, observations, stations, provider_info, product_info, ProviderHandle, CatalogSource, and map_stations are absent; explicit products() and map() survival regressions; an installed-wheel public-surface smoke check; and all five required gates succeeding: uv run ruff format, uv run ruff check --fix, uv run ty check src, uv run pytest, and uv build. This step neither changes RawMode publicness nor adds or removes fetch raw= or on_issue=, and schedules no version bump or tag.
